page.layout: No printed text. The scan shows the fore-edge or spine of a book block (paper edges, stained and torn) against a dark leather-look background, with dark cloth or headband at the top and bottom.
page.notes: The scan shows only the edge of a book block and its surroundings, not a printed page. Nothing is printed on it, so there is no text, page number, running head, catchword or signature to transcribe. The dark background is the cover or support material, not part of the printed page.
